column1: # The docs clips: name<TAB>mission values (JSON)<TAB>title headline<TAB>title line.
# Seeds were picked from `plan_guard --matrix` runs for each policy's typical outcome; the
# simulator does not always agree (docs/details/guard-footage.md). Run: clips.sh [names...]

column4: Meet each attacker out on its line to the VIP, at its own height; with a spare defender, send one round the side (a pincer).
Each defender owns a slice of the sky round the VIP and only fights inside it. Weak when several attackers crowd one slice.
Two defenders pair up to go out and outnumber one attacker; the rest guard the VIP close.

column3: RING  (defence, baseline)  v coordinated  ·  rules: tag
column4: The escort's idea: a flat ring round the VIP that turns to face the nearest attacker.
Take up positions all round, then go in together, behind a decoy or after a feint; back off and come again when blocked.
Spread out evenly round the VIP, then everyone charges at once, weaving.
Gang up on the loneliest defender first; go for the VIP once the defence is thinned out.

column3: DIRECT  (attack, baseline)  v shell  ·  rules: tag
column4: Straight at the VIP, at full speed, all at once.
Outnumber a drone two to one to take it out, but only on the other side's ground (near the VIP is the defence's).

column3: Rules: TIMER (30 s clock)  ·  hunter v flood
column4: Nobody is taken out: the defence can only get in the way, and wins by holding out until the clock runs out.
